comment: PROBE (never in dist/): burns a set number of cycles per callback so the point where the pedal starts to crackle gives the real DSP capacity left to one effect. Mode 0 = arithmetic only (emulated = real cycles), 1 = a 64 KB walk (cached), 2 = a walk over the whole arena (memory misses).
fxid_comment: Probe ID, unused elsewhere (908-913 were retired test effects).

params.name: kCyc
params.comment: params[5]. Thousands of emulated cycles burnt per callback. Defaults to 0: installing it costs nothing.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: params[6]. 0 arithmetic (no memory), 1 cached walk (64 KB), 2 uncached walk (the whole arena).

params.name: Tone
params.comment: params[7]. 1 replaces the input with a 1 kHz sine at -12 dB (dropouts are easy to hear), 0 passes the input through.
